title.narrative: Promotion of CSR in Vietnamese SMEs

description.narrative: The immediate objective for the project is the uptake of government policy, strategy, instruments and/or initiatives that further do mesticate and promote good CSR practices and enable their management integration by Vietnamese. The project will therefore work towards further strengthening awareness and improving understanding of the needs, challenges and business opportunities specific to each of the core CSR subjects. Moreover, it will work towards fostering implementation of effective and efficient CSR practices for enterprises and CSR enabling policy options for policy makers.
